text:
Anya Feldman: VectorAI submitted a dispute — their March invoice shows a reserved commit change plus a vendor pass-through charge that they say was billed twice. INV-2026-03-142 attached.
Rahul Chatterjee: I looked at the ledger: Line 21 reserved commit 0.8 -> $9,600; Line 37 vendor pass-through 'partner GPU' 12 hrs = $840; Line 58 burst overage 4 hrs = $480. Customer says partner fee also appears embedded in reserved pricing.
Maya Ortiz: we onboarded partner GPUs for VectorAI in Feb; contract said partner pass-through billed separately only for ad-hoc burst. If their reserved capacity consumed partner nodes during Mar1-3 failover, we shouldn't double-bill. Need event logs.
Rahul Chatterjee: event log snippet: 
```
2026-03-02T22:14Z healthcheck: pool-west-3 node failure
2026-03-02T22:18Z autoscale: failover -> borrow-partner-gpus id=pb-88 hours=12
2026-03-03T03:10Z cluster-recover: returned pb-88
```
Anya Feldman: support ticket SUP-6418 shows VectorAI asked to opt out of partner borrowing after first hour; rep note says we continued borrow until recovery. Vector wants refund for partner pass-through and reduction in burst.
Theo Park: contract review: partner pass-through should be waived if borrowing caused by our infrastructure failure (maintenance/bug). Did this start from our node failure? logs indicate yes.
Maya Ortiz: propose refund partner pass-through fee $840 and re-evaluate burst classification: 4 hrs burst were actual extra GPU-hours routed; recommend waive 3 of 4 hrs as forced failover (refund $360). Total proposed credit $1,200.
Anya Feldman: policy requires finance lead signoff for discretionary credits > $1,000. Also need vendor dispute opened to recover partner cost.
billing-bot: Created ADJ-2026-4723 for VectorAI. Artifacts: SUP-6418, partner-pass-through-invoice.pdf, autoscale-events-03-02.log. Status: awaiting_finance_lead_approval.
Rahul Chatterjee: I'll open vendor dispute PD-219 and attach the autoscale evidence; vendor may refund the pass-through or issue future credit.
Maya Ortiz: I've drafted customer note: "We're applying a corrective credit of $1,200 to your next invoice for partner pass-through and forced-failover burst hours. We're also pursuing recovery from our partner. Apologies for the disruption."
Anya Feldman: good. @billing-bot please flag ADJ-2026-4723 as discretionary and queue for April billing run if approved.
billing-bot: ADJ-2026-4723 flagged discretionary. Awaiting finance lead approval.
Theo Park: one more ask: capture this as a policy exception and recommend a rule: "if partner borrowing is triggered by our infra failure, partner pass-through should be refunded automatically" to avoid churn. I'll file a product request.
Anya Feldman: agreed. I'll escalate to finance lead for approval and loop in legal for vendor contract language.
billing-bot: ADJ-2026-4723 status updated: approved_by_finance_lead. Scheduled for billing run 2026-04-03. Journal JE-2026-8010 created. Customer notified.
Anya Feldman: thanks team. follow-up: PD-219 vendor dispute opened; product ticket PR-498 to add automatic partner-borrow detection. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
